author: Bobby Grayson
description: The verifier independently judged the fairness hypotheses to be plain weak fairness (disabled infinitely often or taken infinitely often) with enabledness = non-empty mailbox / non-empty signal queue; head position is earned by rank measures, never assumed. The lock's only extra assumption is that a holder is eventually ticked.
title: Integrator caught two vacuity bugs in freshly proven liveness theorems: runs had to step forever so a quiescent system had no run at all, and a closed run from init could never lose its child, so the premise was unreachable. Both fixed by strengthening (idle steps; theorem from any Good start plus a reachability witness). Lesson: a liveness theorem needs a non-vacuity witness next to it, the same way a safety invariant needs a mutant
